verses.1: And after Moses’ death, Jehovah’s servant became Yehoshua ben Nun. Jehovah said to him, “Be the servant of Moses.”
verses.2: Moses, my servant has died. Now, you and all this people must cross this Jordan River. You and all of you must go to the land that I have given to the children of Israel.
verses.3: Every place where your feet tread, I will give it to you, just as I said to Moses.
verses.4: From the desert and this Lebanon, all the way to the great river Euphrates. All of the land of Hittites, and even as far as the great sea. The sun will shine upon you as your border.
verses.5: No one will stand before you throughout your life. Just as I was with Moses, so too will I be with you. I will not leave you or abandon you.
verses.6: Strengthen and persevere, for you will be the one to lead this people into the land that I have promised their ancestors.
verses.7: Be strong and endure much pain in order to keep doing all the commandments that Moses, my servant, commanded you. Do not forget these commands, for they are important so that you may know what to do in everything you do.
verses.8: Do not abandon this Book of Revelation. Use it day and night, so that you may keep all that is written in it. Then you will be able to follow your path successfully.
verses.9: Do not be weak or discouraged. For the LORD your God will be with you in all things you do.
verses.10: And Joshua commanded the people to say:
verses.11: Go through the camp, and command the people to say, “Prepare yourselves for the journey. In three days, you will cross this Jordan River in order to take possession of the land that Jehovah your God has given you to possess.”
verses.12: And to my men, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said, “…”
verses.13: Remember what Moses, the servant of Jehovah, commanded you: “Jehovah, your God, will give you this land.”
verses.14: May you settle down in the land that Moses gave you across the Jordan. You shall go through it fifty days before your brothers, all the leaders of the tribes. And you shall help them.
verses.15: Until Jehovah gives our ancestors their inheritance, and they may also inherit the land that Jehovah, your God, has given them. Then you shall return to your own land, and you shall inherit it, just as Moses, a servant of Jehovah, gave you the land across the Jordan, from the east side of the sun.
verses.16: And they answered Joshua, “All that you have commanded us to do, we will do. And whatever you send us to do, we will also do.”
verses.17: Just as we heard from Moses, so too will we hear from you. But Jehovah your God will be with you, just as He was with Moses.
verses.18: Everyone who spits in your face and doesn’t listen to what you say, let them die. But be strong and courageous.
